QuestInfo.name: Train or Die! 1
QuestInfo.0: You certainly have doubts, but you'll give #b#p1202006##k the benefit of the doubt and receive some training from him.
QuestInfo.1: According to #p1202006#, the first training lesson involves eliminating #r#o9300341#s#k. He makes it seem like it's some huge hurdle but they don't sound too difficult.\r\n\r\n#o9300341##r #a217011##k
QuestInfo.2: You eliminated the #o9300341#s with ease. Judging from how enthusiastic #p1202006# reacted, you are even less inclined to trust him.

0.0: I have been studying the historical records on the heroes of #m140000000#, and I focused particularly on their skills. I made sure not to leave anything out when studying the skills. In the end, I came to the conclusion that when the heroes were still beginners, they trained by battling against the #o0210100#s!
0.1: #o0210100#s! Those are the devastating, transparent monsters that are made of that sticky liquid! Piercing that body with the polearm may be a difficult task, akin to breaking an egg with a rock... Wait, was it the other way around? Striking a rock with a cucumber? A chicken eating a boulder?
0.2: Hmmm hmm! Anyway, I do believe #o0210100#s are pivotal to your training as you work towards regaining your heroic form! Eliminating #o0210100#s will do wonders for you! Now, go ahead and take on #r30 #o0210100#s#k!

yes.0: #m140000000# might be too cold for #o0210100#s to live, but do not worry! This is why I've been raising a bunch of #o9300341#s nearby! Now, go ahead and #btake the portal here that leads to the training ground#k, where the #o9300341#s await you!
yes.1: Seriously, no one can match me in my keen ability to anticipate the future!

no.0: No? Why? Battling #o0210100#s is a certified method of training for heroes! I mean, you went through the same thing hundreds of years ago!

1.0: Ohhhh! You managed to defeat 30 #o9300341#s! You are indeed a hero! The immortal hero that weathered the storm and came back! Of course, I didn't mean immortal in the literal sense. I hope you don't literally take that to heart and risk erecting a big tombstone.

yes.0: In any case, amazing work! You have taken your first step towards reclaiming your hero status! Talk to me when you're ready to take on the next challenge.

mob.0: Are you having a hard time defeating #r30 #o9300341#s#k?! I see...indeed, training for heroes is not so easy...but please don't give up. Return to the training ground immediately!
